generated.description: A large white sci-fi spaceship with a long central spine, a blunt nose and a pair of rounded wings, lit with blue-tinted glass windows, glowstone and redstone lamps. It is built mostly from white wool and stone slabs, with quartz accents and an iron-block frame. Roughly 62 by 144 by 233 blocks, it is a very big vessel; the interior has chests, levers, hoppers and signs, suggesting a working control room.
